name: SSO - Gate-Only Auth App
short_descr: SSO auth app for the gate-only variant. Handles identity-provider federation and issues signed HS256 session tokens.

params.name: SESSION_SECRET
params.descr: Random 32-byte base64url string. Signs OAuth/SAML flow cookies in all variants; also signs HS256 session tokens in gate-only and header variants.

params.name: SSO_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Token audience claim. The filter rejects any token whose aud doesn't match. Must be identical across both apps.

params.name: SSO_ISSUER
params.descr: Token issuer claim. Validated only when set on both apps.

params.name: SSO_PROVIDERS
params.descr: Comma list of providers to show (google,github,microsoft,facebook,saml). Omit to show all configured providers.

params.name: SSO_CLAIMS
params.descr: Comma list of identity claims to include beyond sub.

params.name: SSO_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
params.descr: Comma list of absolute origins allowed as ?redirect= targets after login.

params.name: SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the cookie carrying the session token. Must be identical across both apps.

params.name: CANONICAL_HOST
params.descr: Hostname enforced via 301 redirect, keeping OAuth/SAML callback URLs stable.

params.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console.

params.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: OAuth 2.0 client secret from Google Cloud Console.

params.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Google Cloud Console.

params.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: OAuth app client ID from GitHub Developer settings.

params.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: OAuth app client secret from GitHub Developer settings.

params.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: Application (client) ID from your Entra ID app registration.

params.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: Client secret from your Entra ID app registration.

params.name: MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Entra ID.

params.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT
params.descr: Tenant ID, domain, or common/organizations/consumers.

params.name: MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_TENANTS
params.descr: Comma-separated tenant IDs that may sign in.

params.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: Meta app ID from the Meta developer dashboard.

params.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: Meta app secret from the Meta developer dashboard.

params.name: FACEBOOK_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Meta developer settings.

params.name: IDP_SSO_URL
params.descr: Identity provider single sign-on URL.

params.name: IDP_ENTITY_ID
params.descr: IdP entityID.

params.name: IDP_CERT
params.descr: IdP signing certificate in PEM format.

params.name: SP_ENTITY_ID
params.descr: This service provider's entityID.

params.name: SP_ACS_URL
params.descr: Assertion Consumer Service URL.

params.name: IDP_LABEL
params.descr: Text shown on the SAML login button.

params.name: IDP_ICON_URL
params.descr: Icon image URL shown on the SAML login button.

params.name: SAML_CLAIM_MAP
params.descr: JSON object mapping standard claim names to SAML attribute names.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_TITLE
params.descr: Heading shown on the built-in login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_SUBTITLE
params.descr: Subheading shown below the title on the built-in login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_LOGO_URL
params.descr: URL of a logo image shown on the login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_FAVICON_URL
params.descr: URL of the favicon for the login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_ACCENT_COLOR
params.descr: CSS color value used for buttons and links on the login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_BACKGROUND_COLOR
params.descr: CSS color value for the login page background.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_CSS_URL
params.descr: URL of a stylesheet injected into the built-in login page.

name: SSO - Gate-Only CDN Filter
short_descr: SSO CDN filter for the gate-only variant. Verifies HS256 session tokens on every request and redirects unauthenticated users.

params.name: AUTH_PREFIX
params.descr: Path prefix the CDN filter bypasses so the login flow isn't gated.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_URL
params.descr: Where the filter redirects unauthenticated users.

params.name: SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the cookie carrying the session token. Must be identical across both apps.

params.name: SESSION_SECRET
params.descr: Random 32-byte base64url string. Must match the auth-app.

params.name: SSO_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Token audience claim. Must be identical across both apps.

params.name: SSO_ISSUER
params.descr: Token issuer claim. Must match auth-app if set.

name: SSO - Cookie Auth App

params.descr: Public half of the EC P-256 keypair as JWK JSON. Must be the exact public counterpart of SESSION_SIGNING_KEY.
